| # UDS message format - customer tool {#uds-message-format---customer-tool-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                              |                                                                                                                                   |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

CAN ID can be configured from easyConfig tool as below:

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   CAN ID configuration must not be overlapped with ASW CAN ID from the CAN API bds_can_sendData.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CAN IDs can be configured from easyConfig tool as below:

## Standard CAN ID for 29 bit identifier: {#standard-can-id-for-29-bit-identifier .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

According to ISO 15765-2,

 Physical Request CAN ID    :  0x18DA\<TA\>\<SA\>

 Physical Response CAN ID  :  0x18DA\<SA\>\<TA\>

 Functional Request CAN ID :  0x18DBFF\<TA\> (Optional Configuration)

## Non standard CAN ID for 29 bit identifier: {#non-standard-can-id-for-29-bit-identifier .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

Example:    

 Physical Request CAN ID    :  0xYYYY\<TA\>\<SA\>

 Physical Response CAN ID  :  0xYYYY\<SA\>\<TA\>

 Functional Request CAN ID :  0xYYYY\<TA\>\<SA\> (Optional Configuration)  

where,

TA  - Target address is the ECU node ID which can be configured from easyConfig.

SA  - Source Address is the tester ID which can be configured from easyConfig.

 

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"} | •The source address 0xFA and 0xF1 is reserved by Bosch Rexroth and must not be used by application. |
|                                                                                |                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                | •The target address i.e., ECU Node ID must be unique for the new UDS instances.                     |
|                                                                                |                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                | •Only \<TA\> and \<SA\> can be configured from easyConfig.                                          |
|                                                                                |                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                | •The configuration of the functional Request Id in easyConfig is optional and not mandatory.        |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

## Non standard CAN ID for 11 bit identifier: {#non-standard-can-id-for-11-bit-identifier .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

 Configuration of  CAN ID(MIN)   : 0x001

 Configuration of  CAN ID(MAX)  : 0x7FF

 

Note:  In case of the Non-Standard CAN ID the request CAN ID can be linked with any response CAN ID.

          The request and response CAN ID\'s can be configured from the easyConfig.
